question: Diagonals of trapezium ABCD with AB || DC intersect at O. Show AO/BO = CO/DO.
options: In ΔAOB and ΔCOD: ∠OAB = ∠OCD, ∠OBA = ∠ODC (alternate interior). ΔAOB ~ ΔCOD (AA) => AO/CO = BO/DO => AO/BO = CO/DO.
explanation: In ΔAOB and ΔCOD: ∠OAB = ∠OCD, ∠OBA = ∠ODC (alternate interior). ΔAOB ~ ΔCOD (AA) => AO/CO = BO/DO => AO/BO = CO/DO.

question: If a line intersects sides AB and AC of ΔABC at D and E respectively and is parallel to BC, prove AD/AB = AE/AC.
options: Since DE || BC, AD/DB = AE/EC by BPT. Taking reciprocals: DB/AD = EC/AE. Adding 1 to both sides: (DB+AD)/AD = (EC+AE)/AE
explanation: Since DE || BC, AD/DB = AE/EC by BPT. Taking reciprocals: DB/AD = EC/AE. Adding 1 to both sides: (DB+AD)/AD = (EC+AE)/AE => AB/AD = AC/AE. Inverting back: AD/AB = AE/AC.
